name: larch
description: Multi-agent workflow automation for Claude Code: issue-anchored `/design` (one direct-drafting flow; plan-review panel), `/file-bug` (consumer issue-filing helper), `/deps` issue dependency audits, and `/implement` (positional `<issue-N>`, fixed 7200s Step 2 timeout, optional `--merge`, `--forked`, `--draft`, `--no-admin-fallback`, `--no-logs-commit`, `--coder`, `--run-id`). `/implement` Preflight reads the `larch:plan` block from the issue body; `/implement` Step 5 code review always uses the unified strict panel internally (public `--panel` argv removed).

cursor_model.title: Cursor Model
cursor_model.description: Default model for Cursor launches (e.g., gpt-5.4-medium). Also accepted via LARCH_CURSOR_MODEL env var. Reviewer-panel rows may override this per slot with auto. When unset, defaults to composer-2.5 (with max-mode engaged via scripts/cursor-wrap-prompt.sh).

codex_model.title: Codex Model
codex_model.description: Strong/default Codex model for untagged launches such as brainstorm, negotiations, health probes, and callers that do not pass --model-role. Also accepted via LARCH_CODEX_MODEL. When unset, defaults to gpt-6-astra. Step 2 Codex implementers with an explicit difficulty use gpt-5.6-terra unless pinned. Review panels, voters, and fixers use their role env vars and tier routing before falling back to gpt-5.6-luna or gpt-5.6-terra.

codex_effort.title: Codex Effort
codex_effort.description: Codex reasoning effort at launch sites that pass --with-effort or use internal effort-enabled launchers (review, implementation, voting, health probe): minimal, low, medium, or high. Unlike model routing, there are no per-role effort variants—review, vote, and fix roles share this same effort level. Also accepted via LARCH_CODEX_EFFORT env var. When unset, defaults to 'high' at those launch sites. launch-codex-exec callers that omit --with-effort (design drafter, /research lanes, plan autofix, lint-fix) ignore this setting.
